cd /workspace/services/ingestion && cat > test_ingestion3.ts << 'EOF'
import * as dotenv from 'dotenv';
dotenv.config({ override: true });
import { createNormalizerWorker, rawEventsQueue } from './src/queue';
import { processRawEvent } from './src/normalizer';
async function main() {
  console.log('=== Processing remaining queue jobs ===');

  // Start normalizer worker
  const worker = createNormalizerWorker(processRawEvent);
  worker.on('completed', (job) => {
    // Silent
  });
  worker.on('failed', (job, err) => {
    console.error(`[normalizer] Job ${job?.id} failed:`, err.message);
  });
  console.log('[✓] Normalizer worker started');
  // Wait for all jobs to complete (check every 5 seconds)
  let lastCount = 0;
  while (true) {
    const counts = await rawEventsQueue.getJobCounts();
    const total = counts.active + counts.waiting + counts.delayed;

    if (total === 0) {
      console.log('\n[✓] All jobs processed!');
      break;
    }

    if (total !== lastCount) {
      console.log(`Processing: Active=${counts.active}, Waiting=${counts.waiting}, Total remaining=${total}`);
      lastCount = total;
    }

    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000));
  }
  // Final stats
  const finalCounts = await rawEventsQueue.getJobCounts();
  console.log('\n=== Final Queue Stats ===');
  console.log(`Active: ${finalCounts.active}`);
  console.log(`Completed: ${finalCounts.completed}`);
  console.log(`Failed: ${finalCounts.failed}`);
  console.log(`Waiting: ${finalCounts.waiting}`);
  await worker.close();
  console.log('\n[✓] Done');
}
main().catch(err => {
  console.error('Fatal error:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});
EOF
